meta.name: SafetyModule
meta.label: Safety
meta.description: Protect your server with our anti-raid, anti-spam, anti-nuke and captcha tools.

anti_massjoin_level.label: Anti-Mass Join Level
anti_massjoin_level.description: Defines the protection level against mass joins.

3.label: High (Quarantine then kick at raid end)

anti_spam.label: Anti-Spam Level
anti_spam.description: Defines the protection level against message spam.

3.label: High (Block duplicate content if 2 consecutive messages)

quarentine_role.label: Quarantine Role
quarentine_role.description: The role assigned to quarantined users.

anti_invite.label: Block Invite Links
anti_invite.description: Blocks invite links to other servers.

ignored_channels.label: Ignored Channels / Categories
ignored_channels.description: List of channels or categories exempted from anti-spam (comma separated).

anti_mass_channel_delete.label: Anti Mass Channel Delete/Edit
anti_mass_channel_delete.description: Blocks mass deletion and modification of channels.

anti_mass_role_delete.label: Anti Mass Role Delete/Edit
anti_mass_role_delete.description: Blocks mass deletion and modification of roles.

anti_vanity_url_edit.label: Anti Vanity URL Edit
anti_vanity_url_edit.description: Blocks modification of the vanity URL.

channel.label: Captcha Channel
channel.description: The channel where verification will take place if the user dont accept private messages.

vrole.label: Verified Role
vrole.description: The role assigned once the captcha is validated.

show_to_sus.label: Show to Suspicious Users
show_to_sus.description: Forces users detected by anti-spam to redo the captcha instead of being kicked.
